messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Runway positioning + account depth check — quick updates requested

Team — pulling a quick coverage snapshot for finance; attached is a CSV export (20261011-runway_snapshot.csv) with high-level coverage vs. quota by segment. I ran a sweep and flagged accounts with <0.5x coverage and expected close in next 60 days.

Asks (quick bullets):
- Marcus: for the Autonexus opportunity (RWINF-ACME-7421) can you confirm stage, committed close month, and whether procurement has been engaged? I saw regional legal has a vendor checklist in flight.
- Laura: can you run a short commit health check on the mid-market cohort (deal sizes $50–250k) and surface top 5 at-risk accounts with recommended mitigations?
- Jonas: please validate the Q4 coverage assumption used in the attached (I guessed 70% conversion on late-stage pipeline). If you think 70% is optimistic, call it out.

Goal: reconcile to finance model by Thurs EOD so we can adjust our runway ask. If you reply with inline notes I’ll consolidate and send to FP&A.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20261011-runway_snapshot.csv (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runway positioning + account depth check — quick updates requested

Camila — quick notes inline for Autonexus:
- Stage: Contract Review (Legal holding final security appendix).
- Committed close month: Targeting 2026-11 (customer fiscal close 11/30).
- Procurement: Sally Porter at ProcureCo (cc'd below) has the PO path open; they requested SOC2 evidence and a data retention note. I attached a risk map (autonexus-risk-map-v1.pdf) summarizing outstanding items.
- Confidence: 60% given legal dependencies; procurement timeline is predictable but depends on SOC2 artifacts.

Action items: I’ll ping Applied ML today for a short SOC2 evidence pack and ask SRE to confirm retention SLA. If we get the documents by 10/15 we can keep the 11/30 close in the model.

—Marcus

Attachment: autonexus-risk-map-v1.pdf (1 page)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runway positioning + account depth check — quick updates requested

Camila — did a fast pass on the mid-market cohort. Top 5 at-risk (notes):
1) BrightLayer — Late-stage demo success but PO delayed; procurement expects multi-vendor evaluation (risk: 0.45x).
2) Meridian Health — Legal escalation around data residency; needs Private option pricing (risk: 0.4x).
3) VoltIQ — Budget freeze until next quarter; engineering champion left (risk: 0.3x).
4) Autonexus — see Marcus notes (risk: 0.6x unless SOC2 artefacts delivered).
5) Northpoint Retail — negotiating discounts beyond standard; finance wants term concessions (risk: 0.5x).

Recommended mitigations (short):
- Force a 2-week mutual action plan for BrightLayer and Autonexus; get weekly check-ins.
- Offer a limited Private pilot for Meridian to unblock legal (30-day trial, minimal data footprint).
- For Northpoint: hold firm on list pricing, offer deferred invoice dates instead of a larger discount.

I’ll prepare a one-page summary for FP&A by 10/13 AM.

-Laura

Subject: Fwd: Runway positioning + account depth check — quick updates requested

Forwarding to Hana and Sally for transparency. Quick update from my side on the conversion assumption: 70% on late-stage is aggressive for this cohort — I recommend we model 55% for Q4 until SOC2/Evidence/POs are in hand. That reduces our convertible coverage by ~18% overall.

Hana — Marcus and I flagged the legal items; any chance your security team can prioritize the SOC2 scoping call this week? A 30-minute sync would materially change the finance timing.

Sally — appreciate the procurement visibility; if there are standard forms or timelines we should expect please flag them here.

Thanks — Jonas
